comment: ; Programmable frame rotation (manual 3.12.2.4): machine XYZ = R * local XYZ + t.
; TRANS sets the offset, AROT RPL=90 turns the workpiece system a quarter turn
; about Z (G17), so local +X runs along machine +Y. ATRANS after the rotation
; offsets in the rotated system (3.12.2.1), ROT replaces the whole frame
; (the TRANS offset included), and a bare ROT deletes it.
; shifts along the rotated X, which is machine +Y
; half circle in the rotated plane, centre offset rotated to J1
; absolute: the offset is deleted, the quarter turn kept
; bare absolute instruction: the frame is deleted
